turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. On what basis, and who decided?
Thanks for coming in. I owe you an apology: the zero went in before I called you.
Okay. Was Owen heard before that mark went in, or after?
I am withdrawing the zero today. Owen does a private supervised rewrite at lunch. Nothing goes on his record. I will email you that tonight.
I'm writing down "withdrawing the zero today" and "nothing goes on his record." If the zero is gone, then on what basis does Owen rewrite anything, Hale?
Here it is in writing, signed.
Let me read it. The zero and the record, fine, I'll keep this copy. What it doesn't tell me is why my son spends his lunch writing that essay again.
Thank you for your time, Ms. Kalinowski.
I'm not leaving with an open question, Hale. Either you tell me what the rewrite is for, or I take this signed page upstairs to the principal and ask there.
Then the principal's office is my next stop, with your signature in my hand. Owen doesn't sit that rewrite until someone tells me why.
